title: Measures for Labeling Artificial Intelligence-Generated Synthetic Content
title_original: 人工智能生成合成内容标识办法
summary: Measures issued by the Cyberspace Administration of China, the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, the Ministry of Public Security and the National Radio and Television Administration (Guoxinban Tongzi [2025] No. 2). They require explicit labels (visible text, sound or graphic cues) and implicit labels (file metadata, with digital watermarks encouraged) on AI-generated or synthetic content. Duties fall on service providers, content platforms, app distribution platforms and users, and apply alongside the mandatory national standard GB 45438-2025. Maliciously deleting, altering, forging or concealing labels is prohibited.
key_obligations: Providers add visible labels and embed implicit metadata labels in generated content
Platforms check metadata and flag content that is or may be AI-generated
App stores verify labelling materials of apps offering generative AI services
Users declare AI-generated content when publishing it
Do not maliciously delete, alter, forge or conceal labels

sources.title: 关于印发《人工智能生成合成内容标识办法》的通知
